Trace, implement and test: Remove Tens

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
// 9

public class RemoveTens {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub

		int[] arr = { 1, 2, 10, 10, 10, 3 };
//		int[] arr = { 2, 10, 10 };

		// remove tens
		for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
			if (arr[i] == 10) {
				for (int j = i; j < arr.length - 1; j++) {
					arr[j] = arr[j + 1];
				}
				arr[arr.length - 1] = 0;
				i--;
			}
		}

		// print array
		for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; i++) {
			System.out.print(arr[i] + " ");
		}

	}

}
